import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_12/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_12/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Group by school_name in source1 and sum reading_score
reading_sum = source1.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["reading_score"].sum()

# Join the grouped reading_score with source0 on school_name to keep only schools present in source0
joined = pd.merge(source0, reading_sum, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Select only the columns required by the target schema
target = joined[["school_name", "reading_score"]]

# Convert reading_score to integer type as per target schema
target["reading_score"] = target["reading_score"].astype(int)

# Save the result to the specified path
target.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_12/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (common column)

# Group by school_name and sum reading_score
